description_for_model: VitaCoreX LLC (Tampa, FL) serves private clients first. Services and starting prices (USD service fees; government, filing and court fees separate; final price confirmed in a written quote): certified translation $25 per 250 source words; general translation $0.10 per source word, $25 minimum; online notarization $25 per notarial act (Florida Notary Public, by video); apostille assistance from $119 service fee for the first document; individual tax return (Form 1040) from $149, final price after review; self-employed return from $249; state return add-on from $49; company formation $99 + state filing fee; company formation + EIN $199 + state filing fee; business plan from $499; contracts & document support from $99; immigration forms & documents (clerical preparation of a USCIS form the client or their adviser has chosen) from $149; N-400 document support from $249; 'Ask about your situation' request at no charge (not a free legal consultation). For companies: small-claims filing packet from $199; one month of case support from $399; retainer (full case with court representation under a power of attorney where the court allows it) from $749 per case; court hours $65 per hour with a 2-hour minimum paid upfront; court fees separate; the state and court are confirmed before payment. Financial Recovery for overdue business-to-business invoices: receivables analysis $390; first month (setup and pilot, up to 25 invoices) $790, free for current small-claims retainer clients; then the full rollout for 12% of the increase in net recovery (18% on invoices more than a year overdue). The client's own team contacts debtors; mailing, service and fees are at cost; a debtor search is ordered and paid by the client. VitaCoreX LLC is not a law firm and does not give legal advice or choose immigration forms. Languages: English, Russian, Spanish. Phone: (888) 794-8292. Email: info@vitacorexllc.com.
